title: Desktop folder
whyItMatters: People park the files they are working on at that moment on the Desktop: drafts, scans, screenshots and downloads they meant to sort later. Names and dates alone can expose a lot.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Videos, Public, Templates): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Headless installs have no Desktop folder.
